rules.rule: Proof of service must state papers served, person served, date, time and place
quote: Proof of service shall specify the papers served, the person who was served and the date, time,

rules.rule: Service within 120 days after commencement; court may extend on good cause or in the interest of justice
quote: shall be made within one hundred twenty days after the commencement of the action or proceeding
upon good cause shown or in the interest of justice, extend the time for service
rules.note: Revision dated 2026-04-24 is shown as most recent; content of that amendment not reviewed. The L1 order extended time to 120 days from entry. 306-b does not define when service is complete.

rules.rule: Court-directed service when 308(1), (2) and (4) are impracticable
quote: in such manner as the court, upon motion without notice, directs,
if service is impracticable under paragraphs one, two and four of this section.
rules.note: Per WebFetch, paragraph 5 contains no language on when service is complete and does not mention filing proof of service; completion therefore comes from the court's order (L1: 'deemed complete upon such filing' of the affidavit).

rules.rule: Contrast: deliver-and-mail service is complete ten days after proof is filed
quote: service shall be complete ten days after such filing
rules.note: Not applicable to L1; shown to explain why completion under 308(5) depends on the order.

rules.rule: Appearance within 20 days of service, or 30 days after service is complete when served under 308(2)-(5) and other listed provisions
quote: subdivision two, three, four or five of section 308
the appearance shall be made within thirty days after service is complete

rules.rule: Default application must include proof of service of summons and complaint, and proof of facts, default and amount due by affidavit
quote: Proof. On any application for judgment by default, the applicant shall file proof of service of the summons
proof of the facts constituting the claim, the default and the amount due, including, if applicable,
by affidavit made by the party
rules.note: Per WebFetch the phrase 'affidavit of service' does not appear in (f); it requires 'proof of service of the summons and the complaint'.

rules.rule: If plaintiff does not seek default judgment within one year after the default, the court dismisses the complaint as abandoned (unless sufficient cause shown)
quote: Default not entered within one year. If the plaintiff fails to take proceedings for the entry of judgment
within one year after the default
the court shall not enter judgment but shall dismiss the complaint as abandoned, without costs,
rules.note: 'unless sufficient cause is shown' exception is [summary], not quoted.

reasoning: CPLR 320(a) [read]: service under 308 subdivision five -> appearance within thirty days after service is complete.
CPLR 308(5) [read via WebFetch]: no statutory completion rule.
L1 order p.6 [read, OCR]: 'service shall be deemed complete upon such filing' of the affidavit of service.
openPoints: Day counting and weekend/holiday rollover (General Construction Law §25-a) not read [unverified].
Whether filing means NYSCEF acceptance time or submission time is not addressed [unverified].
